The psalm it sets
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 15, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1O LORD, who may abide in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain? 2He who walks with integrity and practices righteousness, who speaks the truth from his heart, 3who has no slander on his tongue, who does no harm to his neighbor, who casts no scorn on his friend, 4who despises the vile but honors those who fear the LORD, who does not revise a costly oath, … 1 more verses PSALM 15 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 15
